caseName: Brotherhood of Railroad Trainmen v. Chicago River & Indiana Railroad
caseNameFull: Brotherhood of Railroad Trainmen v. Chicago River & Indiana Railroad Co.

opinions.text:
ante, p. 30. Motion for leave to file brief of Railway Labor Executives’ Association, as amicus curiae, in support of petition for rehearing granted. Petition for rehearing denied.

Mr. Justice Whittaker took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion and application.
